messages:
Kayla: quick heads-up — API ref for POST /v1/predict now uses batched `inputs: [{text: string}]` in the OpenAPI schema but many examples still show `prompt: \"...\"`. users are copy-pasting and hitting errors.
Sam: saw a support ticket about this, thanks. the inconsistency will confuse SDK users. :grimacing:
Miguel: which page exactly? api-ref or model runbook?
Kayla: api-ref (/docs/api/predict). openapi.yaml was updated for batching but we missed updating manual snippets (curl/py/js/go) and the SSE example.
Priya: python SDK accepts both for now but we should show canonical `inputs` examples and a single legacy `prompt` example with deprecation callout.
Sam: proposal: replace canonical examples with `inputs: [{text: \"...\"}]` everywhere, keep one legacy example labelled DEPRECATED linking to a migration guide. also add a short section for streaming multiple prompts over SSE.
Miguel: +1. i'll open a WIP PR and include: updated OpenAPI examples, regenerated docs artifacts, updated manual snippets, SSE example, migration note, and a Go batch snippet.
Tim: note — run tools/docs-gen after changing openapi.yaml or generated examples will be out of sync and linter will fail in CI. include that in the PR checklist.
Kayla: suggested PR checklist:
- update openapi.yaml example payloads to use `inputs`
- run tools/docs-gen and commit generated files
- update hand-written samples: curl, python, js, go
- add SSE/EventSource example parsing `event.data` JSON and handling partial tokens
- add migration note "prompt -> inputs" with curl + python examples
- update SDK README snippets and changelog entry
- add internal ticket for product announcements and deprecation timeline
Miguel: PR opened as draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 (WIP). added a tiny unit snapshot test for rendered code blocks so we notice regressions.
Priya: i'll add a Go snippet using a small Inputs struct and json tags:
```go
type Inputs struct { Text string `json:"text"` }
// request: []Inputs{{Text: "hello"}, {Text: "world"}}
```
and a Python batch example: `{"inputs": [{"text": "hi"}, {"text": "there"}]}`.
Miguel: added an SSE example that shows parsing:
```js
const es = new EventSource(url);
es.onmessage = (e) => { const payload = JSON.parse(e.data); /* handle payload.partial_tokens or payload.delta */ };
```
Sam: devex — can you sanity-check the SSE example shape and suggest any UX wording for the migration note? the fetch/EventSource snippet needs to show how to reassemble partial tokens across events.
DevEx: will review. recommend an explicit example that accumulates tokens into an array and emits final output once `payload.final === true`. also add a one-liner: "Both `prompt` and `inputs` accepted until 2024-12-31" for clarity.
Tim: add an SDK compatibility plan: accept both shapes for one minor, emit warning, then remove `prompt` in a major. include this in SDK changelog and internal migration tracker.
Kayla: CI note: after running tools/docs-gen, please preview on the deploy-preview URL and confirm code block rendering before merging.
docs-bot: preview available at https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.ai (note: mixed examples until docs-gen commit applied).
Miguel: updated PR with regenerated artifacts and the migration doc. left TODO to follow up on changelog entries for each SDK. tagging reviewers: @Sam @Priya @Tim @DevEx. please review by EOD Thursday if possible.
Sam: will review tomorrow morning. thanks for moving fast on this.
Priya: small follow-up — i added a short CLI one-liner to bulk-migrate old stored prompts to batched inputs for customers who sent us data in the old shape. Miguel added it to the migration guide.
Kayla: once merged, i'll post a short note in #product-updates and schedule the deprecation reminder in the docs release notes.
Sam: this should reduce the support tickets. thanks everyone.
